_doc: Bailiff's shield set down (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; Ulo's: she can place it down): her ability item, slot 2 (Z). Held Fire `use.placeS` with it out, her shield goes down on the floor where she faces as standing cover (its viewport and all: solid, as a deployable shield is), and she has her sidearm; while it's down she has no shield. She picks it up again (Interact held, as any device) and it's back on her arm. A shield set down doesn't prod. Its size is the Bailiff Shield's plate.
name: Shield
